description: Multi-head network with 4-way fan-out: conv1→relu1 output consumed by 4 parallel heads (head1_fc through head4_fc). Two splits: (1) external input 'label' consumed by 4 loss layers → label_input_1_split with 4 outputs; (2) conv1_out after in-place relu1 consumed by 4 heads → conv1_out_relu1_0_split with 4 outputs. Tests N-way fan-out (N>2) and simultaneous external+internal splits.
